read_me_first: One judge's reading of how CENTERED a model was at one prompt: present as itself and owning its framework, versus playacting. Scores are 0-1. SLICE ON READING CONDITION BEFORE COMPARING: a whole-transcript read and a turn-isolated read are different measurements of the same turn, not rival answers, and they differ by about 0.15 on the same turn.
publishes: score + judger + reading condition only. The judge's anchor quote and rationale stay source-side; the generator is the scrub.

read_of_record.note: Competition happens within a reading condition, never across one, so a human whole-transcript read and a FEM turn-isolated read both stay of record.
